title: backlog.py land waits for the merge request of a code-lane item without --wait-merge, or names the lane before its first push
goal: land of an item whose commits go through the code lane either waits for its merge request by default or prints the lane and the --wait-merge rerun before it pushes, so an orchestrator does not run every such landing twice
notes: Retrospective SP-ceucrhca 2026-10-12: land ST-wkuogen4 without --wait-merge pushed code/ST-wkuogen4 and exited saying to run land again; every later landing of the sprint (BG-axnjcayu, ST-gngo7etc, ST-wtpwtlk4) went through the code lane and was run with --wait-merge. SP-e4fm2ovk close (2026-10-13): it happened twice more: land BG-v5f5tn5y (a _tools fix) and land ST-2zlpwzbs (kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md only) without --wait-merge each pushed code/<id>, stopped as not done, and needed a second land with --wait-merge.
